recognize_zh: 芽細胞具豐富嗜鹼性細胞質、明顯核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof）與細小嗜天青顆粒，流式顯示 CD34 亮陽性、CD19 部分陽性且 CD33 偏弱，核型圖箭頭標示 8 號與 21 號染色體的轉位，符合 t(8;21) AML。
features: Large blasts with moderate-to-abundant basophilic cytoplasm, round to slightly indented nuclei and fine chromatin with nucleoli
Prominent perinuclear clearing (Golgi hof) and fine azurophilic granules in many blasts
Scattered maturing granulocytic cells and occasional dysplastic neutrophil in the aspirate
Flow: CD45-dim blasts, bright CD34, CD13+, weak/negative CD33, partial CD19, partial CD117 and CD15
Karyotype: arrows on chromosomes 8 and 21 indicating the balanced t(8;21)(q22;q22.1)
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows increased large blasts with abundant basophilic cytoplasm, conspicuous perinuclear hofs and fine azurophilic granules, admixed with maturing granulocytes including occasional dysplastic forms; similar blasts circulate in the peripheral blood. Flow cytometry demonstrates a CD45-dim population that is CD34 bright, CD13 positive, CD33 weak, with partial CD19, CD117 and CD15 expression. G-banded karyotype shows a translocation involving chromosomes 8 and 21 (arrows). Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with t(8;21)(q22;q22.1); RUNX1::RUNX1T1, which qualifies as AML irrespective of blast percentage.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with maturation (not otherwise specified)
ddx.vs: May look similar, but lacks the characteristic salmon-pink granules/hofs, aberrant CD19 with weak CD33, and the t(8;21) on karyotype.
APL cells have bilobed nuclei or heavy granules with bundles of Auer rods and are typically CD34 and HLA-DR negative, unlike these CD34-bright blasts.
CD19 in t(8;21) is usually dim without strong CD79a/CD22/CD10, and the defining translocation takes precedence over an MPAL diagnosis.
Also core-binding factor AML, but shows monocytic differentiation and abnormal eosinophils with large basophilic granules rather than hof-rich granulocytic blasts.
